children: State Street SPDR S&P MidCap 400 ETF Trust
, which tracks S&P MidCap 400 Index, has declared quarterly distribution of $1.6035, 5.8% lower from prior distribution of $1.7022.
The ETF's ex-dividend and record date is Sept. 18, while the distribution is scheduled to be paid on Oct. 30.
